semantic_content.answer: There are 7 subsets. One example is {1,8}. Exhaustively: a one-element subset cannot sum to 9 because 9 is not in the set; four or more distinct positive elements have sum at least 1+2+3+4=10. The two-element subsets are {1,8}, {2,7}, {3,6}, {4,5}; the three-element subsets are {1,2,6}, {1,3,5}, {2,3,4}. Thus the total is 4+3=7.
